The native editor capture owner reset its CUA kernel after its last preview. Root reset both used automation kernels after saving and inspecting screenshots. Normalized UTC ticks matched the unchanged identity before termination; the resolved diagnostic remains in CARVE-CONCEPTS-CAPTURE-CLEANUP.json. A replacement background helper may restart automatically; its existence is not proof of active capture, and no zero-helper or visual-disappearance claim is made from process counts alone.
